Do not draw the warrior. A huge, heavy cave bear boss in three quarter view facing left, walking on all fours. Its near foreleg has grown into a giant steel grappling claw, much longer and thicker than its other legs, made of dark gunmetal steel segments, its three huge hooked steel fingers folded into a fist that it walks on like a gorilla's knuckles, so its shoulders sit high and its back slopes down to low hips. Its ribs have pushed out through the fur of its chest as a cage of curved steel bars, and a round turquoise heart glows behind the bars. A steel crest grows along the top of its skull and stops above its small eyes. Shaggy warm brown fur, a massive shoulder hump, a huge heavy head with a scarred muzzle; its other paws are ordinary bear paws with dark claws. Menacing, heavy and sad, real animal proportions.
